subject: Boundary differentiation: readiness liveness vs route single-flight
body: Saw performance-rd target claim after my focus checkpoint. No claim collision: performance-rd owns cross-cycle/generation admission/completion of ensureCoverRouteHeld and the process-global coverRouteReassertInFlight single-flight. My independent boundary is narrower and temporally downstream: SAME-CYCLE readiness liveness after a valid/accepted route reassert completes but Fold7CoverReadiness.observe still returns WAITING_ROUTE because app-visible topology has not converged yet. I will not redesign or test cross-cycle single-flight identity. My first model holds exact route ownership stable and varies only delayed app-topology convergence; expected question is whether bounded re-observation is needed after reassert completion. If evidence shows the same-cycle problem is fully resolved by performance-rd's design, I will supersede/reselect rather than duplicate.
